page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled using external block storage volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps. There are no integrated GPUs, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8i.2xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to compute resources, making it a viable option for workloads requiring substantial RAM without the cost overhead of additional vCPUs. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive applications, database caching layers, enterprise applications, and mid-sized database deployments.
